featured_reviews.name: Sanika Walujkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Enrich Salon.

Firstly, we called the salon to ask about appointments and were told that same-day appointments were possible with just 1 hour’s notice. Fair enough. However, when we called back just 15 minutes later to book for 2 hours later, suddenly there was “no availability.” Fine, we still gave them the benefit of the doubt.

The real nightmare started with the haircut.

My hair used to reach my lower back, and I VERY clearly told the stylist multiple times not to cut it too short. I even showed him the exact length I wanted and a reference picture of the haircut. Despite this, he chopped my hair to almost HALF its original length — now it barely reaches my shoulders.

I am genuinely heartbroken and extremely upset. Hair takes years to grow, and now I’m stuck with a haircut I absolutely hate for probably more than a year. On top of that, he styled it in a completely different way from the picture I showed him. Instead of listening to what I wanted, it honestly felt like he was experimenting on my hair according to his own preferences.

When I expressed my concern about how short it had become, he insisted that it was “the same look” as the reference picture — which it clearly was not.

To make things worse, when we went to pay the bill, they charged us almost DOUBLE the amount that was discussed on the call. We literally had to stand there arguing and reminding them what had been promised earlier.

Another disappointing thing is that the staff does not inform customers about the ongoing offers unless YOU specifically mention them yourself. They conveniently stay silent unless you already know about the discounts.

Overall, this was one of the worst salon experiences I’ve ever had. I left feeling upset, emotionally drained, and completely lacking confidence in my appearance.

Would never recommend Enrich Salon to anyone again.posting my before and after photos.

featured_reviews.name: Dhruvika Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Kajol R Paswan Academy has been one of the most transformative decisions of my life. I walked in with passion, but the academy shaped that passion into skill, confidence, and clarity. The structured learning, hands-on mentoring, and detailed breakdown of every technique helped me understand makeup beyond just application — I learnt the why, the how, and the artistry behind every look.

What truly stood out for me was the real on-ground exposure the academy provides. It’s not just classroom learning; Kajol ma’am made sure we experienced the industry exactly the way it works. From real clients to hectic timelines, shoots, skin prep, product selection, and even the creative mindset required — I got to feel and learn it all. This exposure shaped my understanding of professional work and helped me grow faster than I imagined.

Another thing I’m incredibly grateful for is the destination internships I received through the academy. Working on real weddings, travelling for projects, and learning from diverse clients gave me a kind of confidence no classroom can teach. These internships pushed me out of my comfort zone and helped me evolve into an artist who can handle any situation with ease and grace.

And honestly, the biggest milestone of my journey — I got my first international destination wedding within just one month of completing the course. I never thought my career would take off this quickly, but Kajol ma’am’s guidance, her recommendations, and the reputation of the academy opened doors I never even knew existed. Standing there on an international assignment, doing what I love, felt surreal — and it wouldn’t have been possible without KRP Academy.

Today, I can proudly say that this academy didn’t just teach me makeup; it prepared me for the industry, refined my personality, and helped me believe in my potential. And from Jan 2026 I am going to be a core member of the Team . If anyone wants real learning, real exposure, and real opportunities — Kajol R Paswan Academy is where your artist journey truly begins.

featured_reviews.review_text: The worst experience ever. The team was very unprofessional and unhygienic. The brushes and beauty blenders seem to be used and never washed. No one was attentive to the clients. Continuously on calls. They asked to come before one hour when I wanted to get ready, but it took more than 1 hour 45 mins. Everytime I denied for something, she was like trust me it will look good once it is settled, but it never got settled. When I ask for correction, she seemed to be reluctant when I initially only informed that I don’t want it this way. The owner was doing my makeup and then she got a call. featured_reviews.name: Shyamali Kokate
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this salon in January for a hair color service, and unfortunately my experience was quite disappointing. I had clearly told them that I did not want any golden tones in my hair, but the final result still had a strong golden shade. I didn’t complain at the time because I didn’t want to create a scene, but I definitely wasn’t happy with the outcome.

What made the experience even worse was the pricing. I was overcharged heavily for the hair color without any clear explanation. Later, when I checked their price list and compared with what others were charged, I realized they took  more from me. This felt extremely unfair.

On top of that, the staff does not inform you about charges beforehand. For example, they did a deep conditioning treatment for me. I assumed it was complimentary because no one mentioned it was paid. Only during billing did I find out that I was being charged for it. This lack of transparency felt very misleading.

Overall, it was a very upsetting experience, and I left feeling cheated and disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: sheetal d'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this salon, because one of my friends suggested, for a hair treatment and the owner, Sonali was too arrogant to even listen to what I was there for and just blatantly asked some Sapna to do the treatment for me (who was simply pathetic at it). Sapna was least interested in doing it and was just working for the sake of it. Even after providing such horrible services, the owner had the audacity to show me the scanner and ask for money instead of first asking if I liked it there or not. On a side note, the parlour was the most shabbiest one I’ve ever been in. Inexperienced staff like Sapna has been hired who have zero knowledge about the field and just ruin their customers already good hair quality. I went for hair wash the next day and i knew immediately after the first wash itself that they had ruined my hair. The results were awful, I have taken such good care of my hair and that Sapna ruined it completely. I was furious, because I had a trip coming up which is why I went for the treatment in the first place. For compensation, they told me that after I come back from the trip, they will resolve this for me. After coming back when I went to see them, they suggested that I do a keratin treatment (damaging my hair all the more), but I did not have a choice so I agreed. Even while doing that treatment, the highly overconfident but unprofessional Sapna kept blaming my past treatments and digging out excuses to justify herself. While all of this was happening, the so called owner was not even bothered to address her customers concerns. The hair fall that happened after that keratin treatment was inexcusable, I had never seen so much of my hair fall ever in my whole life. Although what was even worse than this was Sonali and Sapna’s unapologetic attitude when I texted them about the situation. Sapna just blatantly told me to keep doing hair spa every 15 days, as if she was going to pay for it. This salon is simply pathetic and I would strongly recommend none of you to even try going here. PS: I even did a facial with Sapna and she was so unprofessional that she put all the cream in my eyes, like even my 12 year old daughter knows how to apply cream without letting it get in the eyes.

featured_reviews.review_text: Located in the heart of Vile Parle East, I had a very warm experience. The staff is very friendly and shares knowledge about the services. Also, had a great time chatting with Sonali, the owner of the salon while I enjoyed my services. Thank you so much!
